scope: Original 79-layer weights, 804K resident cache, independent serial target decoding versus recursive MTP4 request execution. Four interleaved short requests include greedy, keyed top-k and top-p/min-p sampling. Retained-prefix follow-up, exact-prompt replay, cancellation before forward and full lease reclamation. Every sample asserts agreement across all six ranks.
limitations: Short raw-text prompts; no authentic long-context or full chat-template quality gate yet.
Eager execution without CUDA graphs; no generation-speed comparison is claimed.
Four requests interleave through one workspace; continuous batch packing and distributed command/cancellation transport remain to be integrated.
GPU cancellation test is before a forward; mid-forward cancellation and all rejection positions are CPU state-machine tests.
Kept conversation leases count toward four total request slots and cache capacity; an API scheduler must evict terminal leases deliberately when admitting new conversations.
Sampler uses the existing TensorFold CUDA keyed sampling path; serial-token equality for these fixtures is not universal quality proof.

acceptance_summary.scope: Four short raw-text requests,12 output tokens each; excludes first prompt-head sample. Counts only, not wall-clock speed.
